title: metadata-protocol: an upsert seed whose externalId names a field the object lacks is accepted and inserts a duplicate row on every publish, silently
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbWBtYWqaV8NhvUrShB

Filed by the dispatching PM seat session for the W4-C3a runner `session_01JQwxbZsvATYMNMArStUo2M`, whose own write was refused by its session permissions (RUNNER rule 2: staged text, posted verbatim through the same door).

立卡门类别: ① 产品缺陷 — 具名落点 (`SeedLoaderService.loadExistingRecords`, packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts; the seed save / publish probe) + 复现
reach: 公开入口实测一次错误结果 — `PUT /api/v1/meta/seed/...` with `externalId` naming no field is saved `valid:true`, and each `POST /api/v1/packages/ID/publish-drafts` inserts a duplicate row (two independent boots at 7fa9873f)
业务理由: a package author who mistypes the upsert key (or renames the field it names) gets a duplicate of every seeded row on every publish, with a success receipt and no warning. Users then see doubled reference data. Not doing it: silent data duplication on each deploy, discovered only by end users.
动手的读者: the domain:server seat (metadata-protocol seed loader and publish probe); triage first touch confirms the lane, then os-dev.
查重: `seed externalId` → 46 hits, 0 open (#26674, #24624, #24562 closed, different seams); `seed-loader externalIdKey` → 3 hits, 0 open. No duplicate.

QA-source: #28942 · platform-core.seed-mode-matrix · observed beside the clauses

**What happens.** A seed dataset with `mode: 'upsert'` and an `externalId` that is not a field of its object is accepted at save (it reads back `_diagnostics: {valid: true}`) and at publish. Every `POST /api/v1/packages/ID/publish-drafts` of the unchanged seed then answers `seedApplied {"success":true,"inserted":1,"updated":0}` with no probe issue and no log line, and the table gains one identical row per publish. The upsert has silently become `insert` — the replay duplication the build-time lint `seed-insert-mode-duplicates-on-replay` (validate-seed-replay-safety.ts, framework#3434) exists to flag, with no warning here because the mode reads `upsert`.

**Mechanism.** `SeedLoaderService.loadExistingRecords` (packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts) keys each existing row by `externalIdKey(record, externalId)`, and an empty key is never registered. With a field the object lacks, every existing and incoming key is empty, so `decideWriteAction` finds no match and returns `insert`. Nothing between the save door and the loader checks `SeedSchema.externalId` against the object's declared fields, and neither does the publish probe pass (`probes.checked.seeds`).

**Reproduction** (fresh showcase boot at 7fa9873f, admin bearer; reproduced on two independent boots and DBs):
1. `POST /api/v1/packages {"manifest":{"id":"com.objectstack.qa.seedrepro","name":"R","version":"1.0.0","scope":"project","type":"app","engines":{"protocol":"^18"}}}` → 201.
2. `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/seedrepro_other?mode=draft&package=com.objectstack.qa.seedrepro {"name":"seedrepro_other","label":"R","sharingModel":"public_read_write","fields":{"name":{"type":"text","label":"Name"},"code":{"type":"text","label":"Code"}}}` → 200, then `POST /api/v1/packages/com.objectstack.qa.seedrepro/publish-drafts {}` → published.
3. Three times: `PUT /api/v1/meta/seed/r_ghost?mode=draft&package=com.objectstack.qa.seedrepro {"object":"seedrepro_other","mode":"upsert","externalId":"no_such_field","records":[{"name":"G1","code":"g"}]}` → 200, then `POST …/publish-drafts {}`.
4. `GET /api/v1/data/seedrepro_other`.

- Expected: the save or the publish refuses (or at least diagnoses) an `externalId` naming no field of the seed's object; failing that, replays converge on one G1 row.
- Actual: each publish answers `inserted:1` with 0 probe issues; step 4 returns 3 rows named G1 with three ids.
- Control: the same seed with `externalId: "name"` → `inserted:1`, then `inserted:0, updated:0` on replay.

**Fix direction:** refuse or diagnose at the seed save / publish probe when `externalId` (each member, for a composite) is not a declared field of the seed's object; the loader could also warn when every key of a keyed dataset evaluates empty.

Full evidence: QA run record #28942.
